Quantum 1.26.0 was certified on 2026-09-03. It pins **nucleus v1.23.0**, **quark v1.10.0** and **orbit v1.8.17**, with 22 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.25.0: nucleus goes from v1.22.0 to v1.23.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.8.0 to v1.10.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.8.14 to v1.8.17 (patch). 20 sibling modules change version.
